acceptance_criteria.condition: V5 uses ten V10-derived tasks not used by V4, with a hash-bound old/new policy snapshot and a fixed three-condition order per task.
A failed hidden or implementation result after agent exit may advance the per-task score chain, while incomplete, forged, replay-divergent, or protocol-invalid collections remain ineligible.
V5 replays an empty candidate diff as the public seed and normalizes only volatile unittest duration and controlled scorer worktree paths.
The package regression suite, pytest suite, type check, compilation, Skill validation, snapshot parity, and diff hygiene pass before collection.

invariants: Each task has exactly three preregistered conditions in a fixed per-task order; later conditions require every predecessor to have an agent-exit record and a scored_after_agent_exit credential.
A failed hidden or implementation-integrity result is retained as a completed sample for sequencing; it cannot be silently dropped and still makes final collection eligibility fail.
The repair agent receives only its task workspace and the applicable frozen Skill snapshot; hidden tests, reference fixes, scoring rubric, prior outputs, and condition outcomes remain unavailable.

The analyzer rematerializes the frozen corpus, replays candidate diffs, and rejects mismatched provenance, pre-score artifact hashes, results, sequence credentials, extra task files, and retry directories.
The parent Harness remains trusted for native identity and transcript recording; this is shared-filesystem protocol isolation, not container isolation or cryptographic attestation.
This frozen protocol is not evidence that the Skill improves repair success, model-wide causal reasoning, or production reliability before complete eligible collection and the preregistered analysis.

events.redaction_review: Only fixed task and condition identifiers are recorded; no credentials, payloads, or user-controlled labels are emitted.

instrumentation.cardinality_review: The task IDs and three condition labels are preregistered and bounded; the event does not contain source content or secrets.
instrumentation.threshold_and_action: A missing post-exit score credential blocks the next condition; any completeness or integrity failure produces an ineligible analysis result.
instrumentation.evidence: Focused protocol tests assert the post-exit scoring and failed-predecessor chain behavior.

safeguards.name: frozen preregistration
safeguards.rationale: The V5 preregistration binds the corpus, generators, runner, base scorer, analyzer, prompt, old/new Skill snapshots, task order, model/Harness scope, and stopping rule before trial collection.

safeguards.name: failure-preserving sequence chain
safeguards.rationale: A real failed sample remains in the chain rather than blocking later conditions or disappearing from analysis; final completeness still rejects failed integrity or hidden contracts.

safeguards.name: blind replayed scoring
safeguards.rationale: The analyzer rebuilds the public workspace and reruns the hidden scorer from each recorded diff, including pristine replay for an empty diff.

safeguards.name: snapshot parity
safeguards.rationale: The treatment snapshot and the normative SKILL.md are byte-identical after the literal-old-contract-marker correction.

safeguards.name: independent review
safeguards.rationale: A separate read-only native reviewer checked V4 failure closure, provenance, replay, anti-tamper coverage, and claim boundaries.

design_boundary.rationale: Corpus materialization, condition preparation/scoring, preregistration, analysis, and evidence validation remain separate deterministic owners.

dependency_audit.rationale: The V5 update uses only the Python standard library, existing Git, existing package tests, basedpyright, and the existing Skill validator.

extension_decision.rationale: The protocol has no production extension point or new public runtime abstraction.

data_ownership.rationale: The change creates deterministic local test fixtures and evidence, not mutable business or personal data.

error_model.rationale: Missing, forged, out-of-order, replay-divergent, incomplete, or extra artifacts make collection ineligible; a completed behavioral failure remains an explicit failed sample.

contract_evolution.rationale: V5 uses fresh task IDs not sampled by V4 and does not reinterpret or retry V4's ineligible data.

operational_budget.rationale: Focused V5 checks completed in 27.253 seconds; the full unittest and pytest suites completed in about 112 seconds; preregistration caps agents at 300 seconds and scorer checks at 20 seconds.

threat_boundary.rationale: The protocol detects malformed or inconsistent local artifacts but explicitly excludes a malicious trusted parent, filesystem escape, and cryptographic identity attestation.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The V5 freeze has hash-linked checks, independent review, a clean diff check, and an atomic Lore commit before any trial collection.

release_recovery.rationale: No deployable service, rollout, feature flag, or production release changed.

data_migration.rationale: No production persistence, schema, backfill, or migration changed.

configuration_secrets.rationale: V5 records no credential, runtime configuration, or secret; it uses the native subagent Harness supplied by this session.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: No dependency manifest, lockfile, package version, or third-party runtime dependency changed.

operational_knowledge.rationale: README, the preregistration, archived V4 invalidation record, and evidence ledger state how to run and interpret V5 without overstating its assurance.

reproducibility.rationale: Inputs are hash-bound; analysis rematerializes public task workspaces and replays each candidate; task order and stopping rules prevent selective retries.

remaining_risks: No V5 trial has run yet, so the current evidence proves protocol readiness rather than a Skill-effect result.

A party controlling every local raw artifact and the trusted parent could rewrite a collection and recompute its hash chain; append-only remote attestation or container isolation would be required for stronger assurance.

Even a complete eligible 30-trial V5 collection only compares the preregistered fixed model, native Harness, snapshots, corpus, and scorer; it cannot prove model-wide causal ability or production repair success.
Any failed, interrupted, incomplete, or protocol-invalid V5 collection remains ineligible, with no selective retry.
